import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Dimensionless entries; the product is bilinear, not Hermitian. mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TERRACOTTA = "#C66B4E" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
def text(x, y, content, size=12, color=INK, weight="normal", **kwargs): return ax.text( x, y, content, fontsize=size, color=color, fontweight=weight, ha="left", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes, **kwargs )
text(0.05, 0.945, "Self-products in four dimensions", size=17, weight="semibold") text( 0.05, 0.873, r"Bilinear sum $\sum_{n=0}^{3} v_n v_n = v^{\mathsf{T}}v$" " • No complex conjugation", size=10.5, color=SLATE )
# A single quiet divider separates the two comparisons. ax.plot([0.505, 0.505], [0.205, 0.805], color="#E5EAE8", linewidth=1, transform=ax.transAxes)
text(0.05, 0.779, "REAL VECTOR", size=11, color=BLUE, weight="semibold") text(0.55, 0.779, "COMPLEX VECTOR", size=11, weight="semibold")
text(0.05, 0.702, r"$c_1=[1,\ 0,\ -1,\ 0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", size=14) text(0.55, 0.702, r"$u_1=[1,\ i,\ -1,\ -i]^{\mathsf{T}}$", size=14)
ys = [0.607, 0.531, 0.455, 0.379] real_products = [ r"$1 \times 1 = +1$", r"$0 \times 0 = 0$", r"$(-1)\times(-1)=+1$", r"$0 \times 0 = 0$", ] complex_products = [ r"$1 \times 1 = +1$", r"$i \times i = -1$", r"$(-1)\times(-1)=+1$", r"$(-i)\times(-i)=-1$", ]
for n, y in enumerate(ys): text(0.065, y, rf"$n={n}:$", size=12, color=SLATE) text(0.175, y, real_products[n], size=13) text(0.565, y, rf"$n={n}:$", size=12, color=SLATE) text( 0.675, y, complex_products[n], size=13, color=TERRACOTTA if n in (1, 3) else INK )
text(0.05, 0.259, r"$\mathrm{Sum}=1+0+1+0=2>0$", size=14, color=BLUE) text(0.55, 0.259, r"$\mathrm{Sum}=1+(-1)+1+(-1)=0$" + "!", size=14)
text( 0.05, 0.119, r"For real numbers, $x \times x \geq 0$ always. " r"For imaginary numbers, $i \times i=-1<0$,", size=10.5 ) text( 0.05, 0.060, "causing positive and negative terms to cancel out to 0.", size=10.5 )
